claim_boundary: No public Pareto/crossover claim until measured CPU/GPU telemetry, same error envelope, and independent reference gates pass.

frontier_acceptance_gate.reason: No measured CPU/GPU result rows, reference oracle, or pre-registered crossover hypothesis are attached in this contract build.

measurement_requirements.cloud_cost: cloud SKU and dated billing-rate profile required; dollars remain published-rate x measured device-seconds, not a directly measured physical quantity.
measurement_requirements.cpu_energy: RAPL or equivalent measured package energy required; cloud VMs often do not expose powercap/MSR, so CPU energy may require bare-metal.
measurement_requirements.frequency_control: record CPU governor/frequency and GPU clocks where available.
measurement_requirements.gpu_energy: NVML measured power/energy required; integrate power over a multi-iteration measurement window, not a single short engine.
measurement_requirements.memory: peak CPU RSS and GPU memory high-water mark required.
measurement_requirements.repeats: N>=3 fresh-process correctness repeats plus >=10 telemetry windows per method/target/budget for energy dispersion.

method_inventory.claim_boundary: candidate lane only until binary hash, version, and telemetry attach

must_not_claim: Do not claim NVIDIA-grade Pareto frontier from V1 analytic diagnostic.
Do not rank energy or cost from wall time multiplied by constants.
Do not compare closed-form analytic answers against sampling workloads as a performance win.
Do not claim CPU/GPU crossover before both CPU and GPU measured telemetry rows exist.
Do not claim method accuracy against a stochastic reference unless reference CI is included in the acceptance envelope.
Do not describe the crossover after the fact without a pre-registered hypothesis hash.
Do not claim withheld_runtime performance from a review-only/candidate runner.

cpu.vm_warning: ordinary cloud VMs often do not expose RAPL/MSR; CPU energy may require *.metal or provider telemetry API

measurement.short_engine_policy: repeat workload inside timed telemetry window; record iterations_per_window

preregistration_policy.reason: Crossover must not be described only after seeing the measured result.

reference_oracle_policy.external_anchor_status: No third-party implementation currently covers all V2 regimes; per-regime reference anchors must be named before measured run.
reference_oracle_policy.method_vs_method_warning: If the reference is another stochastic method, its own uncertainty is part of the envelope; raw absolute difference alone is invalid.
reference_oracle_policy.reference_disagreement_policy: REFERENCE_DISAGREEMENT_INCONCLUSIVE; no method receives PASS when reference engines disagree beyond declared tolerance.

default_mixture_common_factor.independence_rule: reference generator cannot share code path with evaluated production/candidate engine
default_mixture_common_factor.minimum_path_or_resolution: importance-sampling ESS >=1M tail-effective samples plus independent MC crosscheck before public claim

discontinuous_liquidity_loss.ci_method: scenario-stratum CI; discontinuity boundary rows reported separately
discontinuous_liquidity_loss.independence_rule: reference generator cannot share code path with evaluated production/candidate engine
discontinuous_liquidity_loss.minimum_path_or_resolution: stress-grid resolution hash plus >=50M scenario samples before public claim

hawkes_clustered_jumps.ci_method: independent event-shard CI with cluster-size diagnostics
hawkes_clustered_jumps.independence_rule: reference generator cannot share code path with evaluated production/candidate engine
hawkes_clustered_jumps.minimum_path_or_resolution: >=100M event-path equivalents or convergence-certified branching simulation before public claim

merton_jump_diffusion.ci_method: Poisson-stratum CI plus residual sampling CI
merton_jump_diffusion.independence_rule: reference generator cannot share code path with evaluated production/candidate engine
merton_jump_diffusion.minimum_path_or_resolution: condition on jump counts plus >=50M residual samples before public claim

near_singular_correlation.ci_method: rank-stratified CI plus condition-number stability report
near_singular_correlation.independence_rule: reference generator cannot share code path with evaluated production/candidate engine
near_singular_correlation.minimum_path_or_resolution: condition-number ladder with >=50M equivalent paths per accepted rank before public claim

regime_switching_volatility.independence_rule: reference generator cannot share code path with evaluated production/candidate engine
regime_switching_volatility.minimum_path_or_resolution: >=100M state-path equivalents with transition-matrix determinism hash before public claim

skewed_t_mixture.independence_rule: reference generator cannot share code path with evaluated production/candidate engine
skewed_t_mixture.minimum_path_or_resolution: >=100M equivalent paths with mixture-component stratification before public claim

t_copula_heavy_tail.independence_rule: reference generator cannot share code path with evaluated production/candidate engine
t_copula_heavy_tail.minimum_path_or_resolution: >=100M equivalent paths across independent shards before public claim

target_count_formula: 4 dimensions x 5 confidence levels x 8 regimes x 2 metrics = 320 target rows

cpu_energy.preferred: RAPL/package energy on bare-metal or equivalent platform energy counter

gpu_energy.preferred: NVML power integration with sampling timestamps
gpu_energy.short_engine_policy: repeat workload inside a measured window long enough for NVML sampling resolution; record iterations_per_window

latency_scope.headline: end_to_end_device_workload_including_host_to_device_and_device_to_host_when_applicable
latency_scope.engine_only: reported separately, never substituted for end-to-end workload latency

v1_relationship: V2 is a separate measured CPU/GPU benchmark. V1 analytic-tail diagnostic remains review-only and must not be used as NVIDIA-grade evidence.
